l-m-h2-b0d01-01.title: Ingabe log(a+b)=log a+log b iyasebenza njalo?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isisho se-log₂(a+b)=log₂a+log₂b siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza isimo lapho siphuka khona (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.material: Isisho: ezinombolweni eziphozithivu u-a no-b, log₂(a+b) = log₂a + log₂b iyasebenza njalo. Thola u-a no-b abakhombisa ukuthi lesi sisho siyiphutha.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi u-a no-b ezingumzekelo ophikisayo wesisho?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.a: log₂4=2 no-1+1=2, ngakho iyasebenza. Akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.b: a+b=ab=9/2, ngakho amanani amabili alingana. Akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.c: a+b=ab=16/3, ngakho amanani amabili alingana. Akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.explain: Uma u-a=b=4, log₂8=3 kodwa log₂4+log₂4=4. Isamba se-logarithm sihambisana nomphumela wama-argument.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-a=b=4, log₂8=3 kodwa log₂4+log₂4=4, ngakho amanani amabili ahlukile futhi kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.1: log₂a+log₂b=log₂(ab), ngakho alingana kuphela uma u-a+b=ab. Njengoba 4+4≠16, a=b=4 kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h2-b0d01-10.title: Ingabe amagrafu womsebenzi we-exponential nowe-logarithm ahlala ehlangana?
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi amagrafu e-y=aˣ no-y=logₐx kumele ahlangane sihlala siyiqiniso yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze icala lapho singenjalo khona (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.material: Isimangalo: uma a>1, amagrafu e-y=aˣ no-y=logₐx kumele ahlangane. Thola u-a obonisa ukuthi lesi simangalo siphutha.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.a: Ku-x=1, aˣ>x, futhi ku-x=3, aˣ<x, ngakho ihlangana no-y=x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.b: Ku-x=1, aˣ>x, futhi ku-x=2, aˣ<x, ngakho ihlangana no-y=x.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ku-x=2 no-4, aˣ=x, ngakho amagrafu amabili ayahlangana.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.explain: Uma a=2, khona-ke 2ˣ>x, ngakho x>log₂x. 2ˣ ingaphezu kuka-y=x futhi log₂x ingaphansi kwawo, ngakho ayihlangani.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s2.model.0: Uma a=2, khona-ke 2ˣ>x no-x>log₂x, ngakho y=2ˣ ingaphezu kuka-y=x futhi y=log₂x ingaphansi kuka-y=x, futhi ayihlangani.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s2.model.1: 2ˣ ihlala ingaphezu kuka-y=x, futhi umsebenzi wayo ophambene log₂x uhlala ungaphansi kuka-y=x, ngakho a=2, ongenayo indawo yokuhlangana, yisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h2-b0d01-13.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi sinθ nayo ikhula njengoba i-engeli ikhula sihlala siyiqiniso yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze icala lapho singenjalo khona (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.material: Isimangalo: ku-0°≤θ≤180°, noma nini i-engeli θ ikhula, inani le-sinθ kumele likhule nalo. Thola ushintsho oluyisibonelo esiphikisayo salesi simangalo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.a: sin10°<sin20°, ngakho inani liyakhula. Livumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.b: Ikhula isuka ku-1/2 iye ku-√3/2. Ivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.r.c: Ikhula isuka ku-√2/2 iye ku-1. Ivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s1.explain: sin90°=1 no-sin150°=1/2, ngakho θ ikhule kodwa inani lancipha. Ngemva kuka-90°, liyehla.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s2.model.0: θ ikhula isuka ku-90° iye ku-150°, kodwa sin90°=1 no-sin150°=1/2 iyancipha, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-13.s.s2.model.1: sinθ ikhula kuze kube ngu-90° bese iyancipha, ngakho ushintsho olusuka ku-90° luye ku-150° luyisibonelo esiphikisayo esiphula isimangalo.

l-m-h2-b0d05-03.title: Ingabe u-P(A|B) no-P(B|A) bahlala belingana?
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi isisho esithi "u-P(A|B) no-P(B|A) bahlala belingana" siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza isimo lapho siphuka khona (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.material: Isisho: Ngemicimbi emibili u-A no-B, amathuba anemibandela u-P(A|B) no-P(B|A) ahlala alingana. Hlola lesi sisho ngamapheya emicimbi engezansi ngokuphonsa kwedayisi elilodwa.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha imicimbi u-A no-B ephikisana nesisho.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.b: Bobabili banemiphumela engu-3 futhi u-A∩B={1, 3}, ngakho womabili amanani alingana ku-2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.o.c: A: 3 noma ngaphansi, B: 4 noma ngaphezulu
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.c: U-A∩B uyisethi engenalutho, ngakho womabili amanani alingana ku-0.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.d: Ngumcimbi ofanayo, ngakho womabili amanani alingana ku-1.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=n(A∩B)/n(B) no-P(B|A)=n(A∩B)/n(A). Ku-obala no-4 noma ngaphansi, ahlukile: 1/2 no-2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-A=obala no-B=4 noma ngaphansi, bese P(A|B)=2/4=1/2 no-P(B|A)=2/3, ngakho amanani amabili ahlukile. Ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.1: Izihlukanisi ziyahluka, n(B)=4 no-n(A)=3, ngakho nakuba u-A∩B ofanayo owemiphumela engu-2, amathuba amabili anemibandela ayahluka.

l-m-h2-b0d05-04.material: Isisho: Imicimbi emibili engenakwenzeka ndawonye u-A no-B ihlala izimele. Ukuzimela kusho ukuthi u-P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B) iyasebenza. Cabanga ngecala lapho amathuba emicimbi emibili engenakwenzeka ndawonye enjengaleyo engezansi.

l-m-h2-b0d05-04.s.s1.r.b: P(A∩B)=0 no-P(A)P(B)=0, ngakho alingana futhi imicimbi izimele.
l-m-h2-b0d05-04.s.s1.r.d: Womabili amanani alingana ku-0, ngakho azimele.

l-m-h2-b0d05-05.material: Isisho: Ukusabalalisa kwe-binomial okubili okunesilinganiso esifanayo nakho kunama-variance afanayo. Isilinganiso sokusabalalisa kwe-binomial u-B(n, p) singu-np futhi i-variance ngu-np(1-p). Hlola lesi sisho ngamapheya angezansi.

l-m-h2-b0d05-05.s.s1.r.d: Izilinganiso ziyahluka, u-3 no-6, ngakho lokhu akukwazi ukuhlola isisho.
l-m-h2-b0d05-05.s.s1.explain: Bobabili banesilinganiso esingu-5, kodwa ama-variance ayahluka: 10×0.5×0.5=2.5 no-20×0.25×0.75=3.75.
l-m-h2-b0d05-05.s.s2.model.0: Izilinganiso zokusabalalisa okubili zingu-5 zombili, kodwa ama-variance angu-2.5 no-3.75, ngakho isisho siyaphuka futhi kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-05.s.s2.model.1: Nakuba isilinganiso np sifana, u-p ohlukile ushintsha u-np(1-p), ngakho u-B(10, 0.5) no-B(20, 0.25) banama-variance ahlukile.

l-m-h2-b0d06-04.title: Ingabe isilinganiso ekwandisweni sihlala singu-nCr?
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo esithi "isilinganiso sika-xʳ sihlala singu-nCr" siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza isimo lapho kungenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.material: Isimangalo: uma u-(ax+b)ⁿ eluliwe, isilinganiso sika-xʳ sihlala siyisilinganiso se-binomial u-nCr. Hlola isimangalo ngokuqhathanisa isilinganiso sethemu elinikeziwe ekwandisweni ngakunye okulandelayo no-nCr.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s1.explain: Isilinganiso sethemu lika-x² lika-(2x+1)³ singu-3C2×2²=12. Sihlukile ku-3C2=3 ngoba isilinganiso 2 sika-x siphindaphindwa singesikwele.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s2.model.0: Ithemu lika-x² lika-(2x+1)³ lingu-3C2×2²=12, kodwa 3C2=3, ngakho izilinganiso ziyahluka. Yingakho lokhu kwandiswa kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo kusimangalo.
l-m-h2-b0d06-04.s.s2.model.1: Ngoba isilinganiso 2 sika-x siphindaphindwa izikhathi ezingu-r (siphakanyiswa ngamandla u-r), isilinganiso siba sikhulu kuno-nCr. Ngakho ithemu lika-x² lika-(2x+1)³ lingu-12, okuhlukile ku-3C2.

l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.b: U-c unquma kuphela ukushintshela kwesokunxele nakwesokudla. Isikhathi sihlala sinjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.c: U-d unquma kuphela ukushintshela phezulu naphansi. Isikhathi sihlala sinjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.explain: Isikhathi singu-2π/|b|. U-a unquma i-amplitude, u-c ukushintshela kwesokunxele nakwesokudla, no-d ukushintshela phezulu naphansi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.0: Isikhathi sinqunywa ngu-2π/|b|, ngakho udinga ukwazi kuphela inani eliphelele luka-b. U-a, c, no-d bahambisa noma bakhulise isimo kuphela.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ukunweba noma ukuhambisa igrafu phezulu naphansi akushintshi ubude obuyisicaba bokuphindeka okukodwa, ngakho u-b kuphela, ocindezela isiqondiso esiyisicaba, unquma isikhathi.

l-m-h2-b0d04-04.title: (√(1+x)−1)/x lingakanani cishe uma x=0.001?
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.goal: Linganisela inani lika-(√(1+x)−1)/x ku-x=0.001 ukuze unqume usayizi noma ububanzi obufanele, bese uchaza ukucabanga kwakho.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.material: Uma ubeka u-x=0.001 ku-f(x)=(√(1+x)−1)/x, kokubili inombolo engenhla nengezansi zisondele kakhulu ku-0. Linganisela usayizi we-f(0.001) ngaphandle kwekhalkhulethha.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.r.a: Nanoma inombolo engenhla incane, engezansi nayo incane, ngakho isilinganiso asiyona u-0.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.r.c: Leli yinani elisuka ekuthatheni u-√(1+x)≈1+x. Eqinisweni licishe libe ngu-1+x/2.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.r.d: Leli yinani elisuka ekufundeni ingxenyana ibheke phansi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.explain: Ukwenza isihlukanisi sibe nengqondo kunika u-f(x)=1/(√(1+x)+1). Uma x≈0, engezansi icishe ibe ngu-2, ngakho u-f ucishe abe ngu-0.5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s2.model.0: Ukwenza inombolo engenhla ibe nengqondo kunika u-1/(√(1+x)+1), futhi uma u-x esondele ku-0 engezansi icishe ibe ngu-2, ngakho inani licishe libe ngu-0.5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s2.model.1: U-√(1+x) mkhulu kancane kuno-1, ngakho inombolo engenhla icishe ibe uhhafu ka-x, futhi ukuhlukanisa ngo-x kunika cishe u-0.5.

l-m-h2-b0d04-13.goal: Linganisela izindleko ezikhula lapho kwenziwa 1 esengeziwe ngemva kwe-100 ukuze unqume usayizi noma ububanzi obufanele, bese uchaza ukucabanga kwakho.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.material: Izindleko zingu-C(x)=x²+10x (ngamayunithi angama-10,000 won). Njengamanje senza izinto ezingu-x=100. Sebenzisa u-C'(100) ukulinganisela izindleko ezikhula lapho kwenziwa 1 esengeziwe.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.r.a: Ubheke kuphela ikhoefishenti elingu-10 le-10x. Washiya ukukhula okuvela ku-x².
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe inani lezinto, 100, njengezindleko njengoba linjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.explain: C'(x)=2x+10, ngakho C'(100)=210. Izindleko ezikhula lapho kwenziwa 1 esengeziwe zicishe zibe ngu-210 × 10,000 won, futhi inani langempela lingu-211 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s2.model.0: Ukukhula lapho kwenziwa 1 esengeziwe kusondele ezingeni lokushintsha kwesikhashana u-C'(100)=2·100+10=210, ngakho kucishe kube ngu-210 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s2.model.1: Njengoba u-x eshintsha ngo-1 kuphela, ushintsho lwezindleko luyi-C'(100)×1≈210, okucishe kufane nokubala kwangempela, 211.

l-m-h2-b0d02-34.title: Ubufakazi bokungenisa bokuthi "n²+n iyinombolo engaphindwayo": yini engekho?
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.goal: Landela izinyathelo zobufakazi bokungena bokuthi u-n²+n uhlala engeyona inombolo ephindwe kabili (ukulandelana kwesizathu nomphumela), uthole lapho siqala ukuphutha khona, bese usilungisa.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.material: Ubufakazi "bokuthi u-n²+n uyinombolo engaphindwanga kabili kuwo wonke u-n wemvelo". (1) Cabanga ukuthi u-k²+k uyinombolo engaphindwanga kabili uma n=k (2) (k+1)²+(k+1)=(k²+k)+2(k+1) (3) engaphindwanga kabili+ephindwe kabili=engaphindwanga kabili, ngakho iyabamba nakwa-n=k+1 (4) Iyabamba kuwo wonke u-n wemvelo
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.a: (1) Lapho kucatshangwa ukuthi isitatimende siyabamba ku-n=k
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuyisicabango esenziwe esinyathelweni sokungena, ngakho kuyalunga.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.r.b: Ukunweba kunika inkulumo efanayo, ngakho kulungile.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.c: (3) Lapho kushiwo ukuthi engaphindwanga kabili+ephindwe kabili=engaphindwanga kabili
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.o.d: (4) Lapho kuphethwe ngokuthi iyabamba kuwo wonke ngaphandle kokuhlola u-n=1
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s1.explain: Isinyathelo esiyisisekelo n=1 asikho. U-1²+1=2 uyinombolo ephindwe kabili, futhi empeleni u-n²+n uhlala ephindwe kabili.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.0: Linesinyathelo sokungena kuphela futhi alihloli isimo sika-n=1, ngakho ubufakazi abusebenzi. U-1²+1=2 uyinombolo ephindwe kabili, ngakho isitatimende asiyiqiniso.
l-m-h2-b0d02-34.s.s2.model.1: Ngaphandle kwesinyathelo esiyisisekelo akukho ndawo yokuqala, ngakho isiphetho se-(4) asikwazi ukufinyelelwa, futhi u-n²+n=n(n+1) uhlala ephindwe kabili, ngakho isitatimende uqobo luyaphutha.

l-m-h2-b0d03-05.title: Ukunqamula uma ingezansi iyisikwele: kwahlulekephi?
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo esithola u-lim (x²−1)/(x−1)² (x→1) (ukulandelana kwesizathu nomphumela), uthole lapho siqala ukuphutha khona, bese usilungisa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.material: Isixazululo: ① x²−1=(x−1)(x+1) ② Ukunqamula nengezansi (x−1)² kusala u-x+1 kuphela ③ Njengoba u-x→1, u-x+1→2 ④ Umkhawulo ungu-2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kubala kulungile, kodwa isinyathelo sangaphambilini besesiphutha kakade.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.r.d: Isiphetho siyaphutha ngenxa ye-②. Akuyona indawo yokuqala yephutha.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s1.explain: (x−1)(x+1)/(x−1)²=(x+1)/(x−1). Njengoba u-(x−1) usala engezansi, umkhawulo awukho.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.0: U-(x−1)² ungaqedwa no-(x−1) kanye kuphela, kusale u-(x+1)/(x−1), ngakho ② iyaphutha.
l-m-h2-b0d03-05.s.s2.model.1: Ngoba u-(x−1) usala engezansi, inani liyanda noma liyancipha ngaphandle komkhawulo uma u-x→1, ngakho akukho mkhawulo. ②, ethathe ukunqamula njengokuphelile, liyiphutha lokuqala.

l-m-h2-b0d03-11.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo esithola u-f'(2) ku-f(x)=x²+3x usebenzisa incazelo (ukulandelana kwesizathu nomphumela), uthole lapho kuqala khona ukuphosa, futhi ulungise.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.material: f(x)=x²+3x. Isixazululo: ① f(2)=10 ② f(2+h)=4+h²+6+3h ③ (f(2+h)−f(2))/h=(h²+3h)/h=h+3 ④ Uma u-h→0, f'(2)=3.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.r.c: Ngokwemiphumela ye-②, lokhu kubala kuyiso. Indawo eyaphosa kuqala ngu-②.

l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s1.explain: (2+h)²=4+4h+h². Ithemu eliphakathi u-4h lashiywa, ngakho kwaphuma u-3 esikhundleni sika-f'(2)=7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.0: (2+h)² kubhalwe njengo-4+h², ngakho u-4h washiywa; ② liyiphutha lokuqala, futhi uma kwenziwe kahle kungu-(7h+h²)/h→7.
l-m-h2-b0d03-11.s.s2.model.1: Ifomula yokuphindaphinda (2+h)²=4+4h+h² ayilandelwanga, ngakho kwaphosa ku-②, futhi kufanele kulungiswe ku-f'(2)=7.

l-m-h2-b0d03-20.s.s2.model.0: Ku-x<0, u-3x no-x−2 bobabili abanegethivu, ngakho umphumela f'(x) uphozithivu, okusho ukuthi ③ liyiphutha lokuqala.

l-m-h2-b0d03-26.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo se-integral emisiwe ka-|x| kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-1 (noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela) ngokulandelana, uthole lapho kuphutha khona okokuqala, bese ulungisa.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.material: Isixazululo se-integral emisiwe ka-|x| kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-1: ① |x| ngu-−x uma x<0 no-x uma x≥0 ② Ngakho shintsha u-|x| ngo-x bese ucoca konke ngesikhathi esisodwa ③ I-integral emisiwe ka-x ngu-[x²/2]=0 ④ Ngakho inani lingu-0.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.o.b: ② Shintsha u-|x| ngo-x bese ucoca konke ngesikhathi esisodwa
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kubala ngokwakho kulungile. Inkinga ngukuthi isisho sisethwe kabi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s1.explain: Ku-x<0, |x|=−x. (i-integral emisiwe ka-−x kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-0)+(i-integral emisiwe ka-x kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-1)=1/2+1/2=1.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s2.model.0: Ku-②, ububanzi bonke bushintshwe ngo-|x|=x, kodwa ku-x<0, |x|=−x, ngakho ububanzi kumele buhlukaniswe.
l-m-h2-b0d03-26.s.s2.model.1: Kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-0 kumele sicoce u-−x, ngakho ② iphutha, futhi ukuhlukanisa kahle kunika 1/2+1/2=1.

l-m-h2-b0d04-15.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo mayelana nemigqa ethintayo ye-y=x³−3x enokuthambeka okungu-9 (noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela) ngokulandelana, uthole lapho kuphambuka khona okokuqala, bese ulungisa.

l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.r.b: Ukwenza lula u-3x²−3=9 kunika u-x²=4, ngakho lokhu kulungile.

l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s1.explain: Uma x²=4, khona x=2 noma x=−2. Kunamaphoyinti amabili okuthinta, u-(2, 2) no-(−2, −2), futhi womabili anokuthambeka okungu-9.
l-m-h2-b0d04-15.s.s2.model.0: U-x²=4 unezixazululo ezimbili, u-2 no-−2, ngakho ③ yashiya u-−2. Kudingeka ukulungisa ngoba kunamaphoyinti amabili okuthinta anokuncika okungu-9.

l-m-h2-b0d04-25.title: Umsebenzi onokuphela kwe-integral ku-x: kwahlulekephi?
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.goal: Landela isixazululo se-derivative ka-g(x)=(i-integral ethile ka-t²+2t kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-x) isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, noma landela uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, uthole lapho siqala ukuphutha khona, bese usilungisa.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.material: Uma u-g(x) eyi-integral ethile ka-(t²+2t) kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-x, thola u-g'(2). Isixazululo: ① Vumela u-G'(t)=t²+2t, ngakho g(x)=G(x)−G(1) ② g'(x)=G'(x)−G'(1)=x²+2x−3 ③ g'(2)=4+4−3=5 ④ Impendulo ngu-5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.r.a: Ilandela incazelo ye-integral ethile, ngakho ilungile.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.r.c: Ukubala kulandela inkulumo ku-②, ngakho ② yaphutha kuqala.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s1.explain: U-G(1) uyinani eliqondile, ngakho i-derivative yalo ingu-0. g'(x)=G'(x)=x²+2x, futhi g'(2)=8.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s2.model.0: U-G(1) uyinani eliqondile elingahlobene no-x, ngakho i-derivative yalo ingu-0. Ku-② akumele sikhiphe u-G'(1), ngakho g'(x)=x²+2x.
l-m-h2-b0d04-25.s.s2.model.1: Umkhawulo ongezansi uyinani eliqondile u-1, ngakho u-G(1) uyanyamalala uma kwenziwa i-derivative ka-g(x). Kumele kulungiswe kube ngu-g'(2)=4+4=8.

l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.b: A: Ngoba zombili ziyizamba ezisuka ku-1 kuya ku-n
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.b: Kubalulekile ukuthi wenza isikwele kuqala noma wengeza kuqala.
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.o.c: B: Ngoba uhlangothi lwesobunxele luhlala lukhulu kunolwesokudla
l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s1.r.c: Ku-n=2, 5<9, ngakho uhlangothi lwesobunxele empeleni luncane.

l-m-h2-b0d01-32.s.s2.model.1: Isamba sezikwele nesikwele sesamba akulingani ngoba u-(1+2)² ukhiqiza ithemu eliphambanayo elingu-2·1·2. U-n=2 uyubufakazi.
